#languages #italian

Collected on trains and at huts. The ones that actually embarrassed me are starred.

- camera = room, not camera (that's macchina fotografica) *asked a hostel in Trieste if my "camera" was safe in the lobby*
- parenti = relatives, not parents (genitori)
- morbido = soft, nothing creepy
- fattoria = farm, not factory (fabbrica)
- libreria = bookshop; library is biblioteca
- caldo = hot. The C tap is hot. Yes, I burned myself in a Trieste shower
- burro = butter, not donkey (that's Spanish, and that's asino)
- annoiato = bored, not annoyed (seccato)
- educato = polite, not educated (istruito)
- estate = summer, not an estate
- magazzino = warehouse, not magazine (rivista)
- *salire = to go up / get on, not to leave. "Devo salire" on the Trieste platform, conductor pointed me back on board*
- simpatico = nice, friendly, not sympathetic
- triste = sad, same as Portuguese for once

Learned most of these on the [[Rail pass Europe]] trip and the rifugio menus in [[Camping in the Dolomites]].
Duolingo never taught me a single one of these, see [[Duolingo streak]].
